card.name: Small words before blood and marrow terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (in, from, of, and, a comma) that come right before a blood or bone marrow term such as marrow, blood, anemia or hemoglobin. The setting is hematology text on blasts, thrombocytopenia and marrow counts.

modes.label: Before marrow or blood
modes.description: A preposition after blasts or megakaryocytes, just before 'the bone marrow' or 'peripheral blood'.

modes.description: A linking word or comma after thrombocytopenia, ahead of another blood disorder term.
